description: This file defines statistical functions for Apache Spark SQL, including approximate quantiles, correlation, covariance, cross-tabulation, and dataset summaries.

methods.name: multipleApproxQuantiles
methods.description: Computes approximate quantiles for multiple numerical columns in a DataFrame with specified probabilities and relative error.

methods.name: pearsonCorrelation
methods.description: Calculates the Pearson correlation coefficient between two columns in a DataFrame.

methods.name: calculateCorrImpl
methods.description: Internal method to compute correlation, supporting only Pearson method between two numeric columns.

methods.name: calculateCov
methods.description: Calculates the covariance between two numerical columns in a DataFrame.

methods.name: calculateCovImpl
methods.description: Internal method to compute covariance between two numeric columns.

methods.name: crossTabulate
methods.description: Generates a cross-tabulation (contingency table) for two columns in a DataFrame.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Computes selected summary statistics for a Dataset, including count, mean, stddev, min, max, and percentiles.
